PhysicalActions.Name: Enable Physical Actions
PhysicalActions.Hint: Enable Skillful Consequences cards for supported Athletics and Acrobatics actions.

SocialActions.Name: Enable Social Actions
SocialActions.Hint: Enable Skillful Consequences cards for supported social actions when this pack contains cards.

SubterfugeActions.Name: Enable Subterfuge Actions
SubterfugeActions.Hint: Enable Skillful Consequences cards for supported Stealth and Thievery actions when this pack contains cards.

KnowledgeUtility.Name: Enable Knowledge & Utility
KnowledgeUtility.Hint: Enable Skillful Consequences cards for supported knowledge and utility actions when this pack contains cards.

PhysicalActions.Title: Skillful Consequences: Physical Actions
PhysicalActions.Description: Action-specific critical successes and critical failures for Athletics and Acrobatics. The normal PF2e result is always resolved first.

SocialActions.Title: Skillful Consequences: Social Actions
SocialActions.Description: Action-specific critical successes and critical failures for supported Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Performance actions. The normal PF2e result is always resolved first.

SubterfugeActions.Title: Skillful Consequences: Subterfuge Actions
SubterfugeActions.Description: Reserved for action-specific consequences for Stealth and Thievery.

KnowledgeUtility.Title: Skillful Consequences: Knowledge & Utility
KnowledgeUtility.Description: Reserved for knowledge, medicine, crafting, survival, and other utility actions.

ReadTheStruggle.Title: Read the Struggle
ReadTheStruggle.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Grapple first. If the same target Escapes before the end of your next turn, your next Grapple check against that target before the end of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus. The bonus then ends.

LockedInLeverage.Title: Locked-In Leverage
LockedInLeverage.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Grapple first. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts by that target to Shove, Reposition, or Trip you.

OpeningForTheTeam.Title: Opening for the Team
OpeningForTheTeam.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Grapple first. The first ally other than you who attempts to Grapple, Reposition, Shove, or Trip the same target before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to that check. The bonus then ends.

OvercommittedHold.Title: Overcommitted Hold
OvercommittedHold.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Grapple first. Your next Athletics check before the end of your next turn takes a -1 circumstance penalty. The penalty then ends.

BreathLostInTheClinch.Title: Breath Lost in the Clinch
BreathLostInTheClinch.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Grapple first. The failed clinch leaves you committed for a heartbeat; you can't use reactions until the start of your next turn.

TechniqueLaidBare.Title: Technique Laid Bare
TechniqueLaidBare.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Grapple first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The target and anyone closely observing the exchange can clearly see how you tried to enter the hold and where your leverage failed.

CleanFollowThrough.Title: Clean Follow-Through
CleanFollowThrough.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Trip first. You may immediately Step up to 5 feet as a free action, but you must end this Step adjacent to the target.

GroundedAdvantage.Title: Grounded Advantage
GroundedAdvantage.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Trip first. Your next Grapple or Reposition check against the same target before the end of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus. The bonus then ends.

FootworkIntact.Title: Footwork Intact
FootworkIntact.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Trip first. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC against attempts to Trip or Reposition you.

StanceCollapses.Title: Stance Collapses
StanceCollapses.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Trip first. Until the start of your next turn, you take a -1 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves and Reflex DC.

RecoveryOutOfSequence.Title: Recovery Out of Sequence
RecoveryOutOfSequence.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Trip first. If you Stand before the end of your next turn, your Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the end of the turn in which you Stand. If you don't Stand before then, this consequence ends with no additional effect.

SetupTelegraphsItself.Title: Setup Telegraphs Itself
SetupTelegraphsItself.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Trip first. There is no additional mechanical effect. Anyone closely watching the exchange can tell exactly how you tried to take the target's footing and where the setup became obvious.

MomentumCarries.Title: Momentum Carries
MomentumCarries.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Shove first. The target's Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn as it recovers from the forced movement.

BrokenLine.Title: Broken Line
BrokenLine.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Shove first. The first ally other than you who attempts to Grapple, Reposition, or Trip the same target before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to that check. The bonus then ends.

OpenToCounterforce.Title: Open to Counterforce
OpenToCounterforce.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Shove first. The first creature that attempts to Shove or Reposition you before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to that check. The bonus then ends.

CommittedDirection.Title: Committed Direction
CommittedDirection.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Shove first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The target and nearby observers can plainly read the direction of force you committed to and where your push lost its line.

ControlledRotation.Title: Controlled Rotation
ControlledRotation.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Reposition first. The first ally other than you who attempts to Trip or Disarm the same target before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to that check. The bonus then ends.

BaseKeptUnderYou.Title: Base Kept Under You
BaseKeptUnderYou.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Reposition first. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC against attempts by that target to Reposition, Shove, or Trip you.

FeetCrossed.Title: Feet Crossed
FeetCrossed.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Reposition first. Your Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the end of your next turn while you recover your stance.

IntendedPathRevealed.Title: Intended Path Revealed
IntendedPathRevealed.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Reposition first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The target and close observers can tell exactly where you meant to put the target and which piece of leverage failed.

SentClear.Title: Sent Clear
SentClear.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Disarm first. If the target drops the item because of that result, you may choose an unoccupied legal space adjacent to the target for the item to land in. If no such space is available, it lands normally.

HandsFreeToFollow.Title: Hands Free to Follow
HandsFreeToFollow.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Disarm first. Your next Grapple or Shove check against the same target before the end of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus. The bonus then ends.

GripOpenedInstead.Title: Grip Opened Instead
GripOpenedInstead.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Disarm first. The first creature that attempts to Disarm you before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to that check. The bonus then ends.

IntentTelegraphed.Title: Intent Telegraphed
IntentTelegraphed.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Disarm first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The target and anyone watching closely can see which item, hand, or grip you were trying to attack and how you meant to strip it away.

RouteLockedIn.Title: Route Locked In
RouteLockedIn.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Climb first. Your next Climb check on the same surface before the end of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus. The bonus then ends.

HandholdForTheNext.Title: Handhold for the Next
HandholdForTheNext.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Climb first. The first ally who follows your route on the same surface before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their next Climb check there. The bonus then ends.

ForearmsFlooded.Title: Forearms Flooded
ForearmsFlooded.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Climb first. Your next Athletics check before the end of your next turn takes a -1 circumstance penalty as you recover your grip and breathing. The penalty then ends.

BadRouteExposed.Title: Bad Route Exposed
BadRouteExposed.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Climb first. There is no additional mechanical effect. Your failed route makes the weak holds, awkward angle, or unstable section you trusted plainly visible to anyone watching.

EfficientStroke.Title: Efficient Stroke
EfficientStroke.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Swim first. On your next successful Swim before the end of your next turn, you may move 5 feet farther than that result would normally allow, if the route is legal. This benefit then ends.

WakeToFollow.Title: Wake to Follow
WakeToFollow.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Swim first. The first ally who follows roughly the same route through the water before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their next Swim check. The bonus then ends.

RecoveryStroke.Title: Recovery Stroke
RecoveryStroke.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Swim first. Before your next Swim check before the end of your next turn, you may spend 1 action steadying your breathing and stroke. If you do not, that Swim check takes a -1 circumstance penalty. This consequence then ends.

SurfaceGivesYouAway.Title: Surface Gives You Away
SurfaceGivesYouAway.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Swim first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The churn, splash, or disturbed water makes the line you tried to take conspicuous to anyone able to observe the surface.

LandingWindow.Title: Landing Window
LandingWindow.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for High Jump first. If you finish the jump standing on a legal surface, you may immediately Step up to 5 feet as a free action.

TakeoffMistimed.Title: Takeoff Mistimed
TakeoffMistimed.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for High Jump first. There is no additional mechanical effect. Your takeoff makes it obvious whether the problem was footing, timing, or a badly judged launch point.

FlowThroughLanding.Title: Flow Through the Landing
FlowThroughLanding.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Long Jump first. Your next Balance or Tumble Through check before the end of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus as you carry the landing into controlled footwork. The bonus then ends.

LandingLineRevealed.Title: Landing Line Revealed
LandingLineRevealed.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Long Jump first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The failed jump clearly reveals where you meant to land and how your momentum carried away from that line.

StableRhythm.Title: Stable Rhythm
StableRhythm.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Balance first. Your next Balance or Tumble Through check before the end of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus. The bonus then ends.

FootingMarked.Title: Footing Marked
FootingMarked.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Balance first. The first ally who follows your route across the same narrow or uneven surface before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their next Balance check there. The bonus then ends.

RhythmLost.Title: Rhythm Lost
RhythmLost.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Balance first. Your next Balance check on the same surface before the end of your next turn takes a -1 circumstance penalty. The penalty then ends.

HazardRevealsItself.Title: Hazard Reveals Itself
HazardRevealsItself.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Balance first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The fall or loss of footing makes the loose stone, shifting beam, slick patch, or other feature that betrayed you obvious to anyone able to observe it.

ExitAngle.Title: Exit Angle
ExitAngle.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Tumble Through first. If you finish that movement on a legal space adjacent to the creature whose space you moved through, you may immediately Step up to 5 feet as a free action.

MomentumPreserved.Title: Momentum Preserved
MomentumPreserved.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Tumble Through first. Your next Balance, High Jump, or Long Jump check before the end of your current turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus. The bonus then ends.

GapDemonstrated.Title: Gap Demonstrated
GapDemonstrated.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Tumble Through first. The first ally other than you who attempts to Tumble Through the same creature before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to that check. The bonus then ends.

FootworkSnarled.Title: Footwork Snarled
FootworkSnarled.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Tumble Through first. Your Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the end of your next turn while you recover your line of movement.

ReactionWindowOpens.Title: Reaction Window Opens
ReactionWindowOpens.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Tumble Through first. Your failed commitment leaves your attention on recovering your footing; you can't use reactions until the start of your next turn.

RouteAdvertised.Title: Route Advertised
RouteAdvertised.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Tumble Through first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The creature and nearby observers can clearly read the gap you tried to exploit and where your route through its space broke down.

AirflowRead.Title: Airflow Read
AirflowRead.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Maneuver in Flight first. Your next Maneuver in Flight check before the end of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus as you carry forward what you learned about the air. The bonus then ends.

WingmatesLine.Title: Wingmate's Line
WingmatesLine.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Maneuver in Flight first. The first ally who follows roughly the same aerial route before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their next Maneuver in Flight check. The bonus then ends.

ControlInputsCrossed.Title: Control Inputs Crossed
ControlInputsCrossed.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Maneuver in Flight first. If you are still flying afterward, your next Maneuver in Flight check before the end of your next turn takes a -1 circumstance penalty. The penalty then ends. If you are no longer flying, this consequence ends with no additional effect.

AirTellsOnYou.Title: The Air Tells on You
AirTellsOnYou.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Maneuver in Flight first. There is no additional mechanical effect. Your failed vector makes the troublesome wind, downdraft, turbulence, or control mistake much easier for observers to identify.

BestAngleFound.Title: Best Angle Found
BestAngleFound.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Squeeze first. Your next Squeeze check in the same constricted passage within 10 minutes gains a +1 circumstance bonus. The bonus then ends.

WhatCaughtYou.Title: What Caught You
WhatCaughtYou.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Squeeze first. There is no additional mechanical effect. Being stuck makes it obvious whether your posture, armor, pack, carried gear, or the shape of the passage caused the jam.

SharedOpening.Title: Shared Opening
SharedOpening.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Feint first. The first ally other than you who makes a melee Strike against the same target before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to that attack roll. The bonus then ends.

CleanPivot.Title: Clean Pivot
CleanPivot.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Feint first. You may immediately Step up to 5 feet as a free action. This movement must leave you able to perceive the target and does not change the normal duration of the Feint result.

ReadTheGuard.Title: Read the Guard
ReadTheGuard.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Feint first. Your next Feint check against the same target before the end of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus. The bonus then ends.

TellSpotted.Title: Tell Spotted
TellSpotted.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Feint first. The target gains a +1 circumstance bonus to its Perception DC against your next Feint before the end of your next turn. The bonus then ends.

AttentionSnagged.Title: Attention Snagged
AttentionSnagged.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Feint first. Your next Create a Diversion or Hide check before the end of your next turn takes a -1 circumstance penalty because your failed deception has drawn attention to your movements. The penalty then ends.

WrongAudience.Title: Wrong Audience
WrongAudience.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Feint first. There is no additional mechanical effect. Someone other than the target who can observe the exchange notices the tell, rhythm, or body language behind your deception and now knows what you were trying to sell.

SharedDistraction.Title: Shared Distraction
SharedDistraction.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Create a Diversion first. The first ally who attempts to Hide before the start of your next turn and can plausibly exploit the same diversion gains a +1 circumstance bonus to that check. The bonus then ends.

ExitCue.Title: Exit Cue
ExitCue.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Create a Diversion first. If you use the diversion to become Hidden, your first Sneak check before the end of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus. The bonus then ends.

StoryTooSpecific.Title: Story Too Specific
StoryTooSpecific.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Create a Diversion first. Your next Create a Diversion check against any of the same observers within 10 minutes takes a -1 circumstance penalty. The penalty then ends.

AttentionRedirected.Title: Attention Redirected
AttentionRedirected.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Create a Diversion first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The failed distraction makes the observers fixate on an unintended detail, person, sound, or part of the scene chosen by the GM; it does not undo the normal critical-failure result.

ConsistentDetail.Title: Consistent Detail
ConsistentDetail.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Lie first. Your next Deception check within 10 minutes to maintain, clarify, or extend the same lie gains a +1 circumstance bonus. The bonus then ends.

BorrowedCredibility.Title: Borrowed Credibility
BorrowedCredibility.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Lie first. The first ally who makes a Deception check within 10 minutes to reinforce the same story gains a +1 circumstance bonus to that check. The bonus then ends.

SecondOrderBelief.Title: Second-Order Belief
SecondOrderBelief.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Lie first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The target draws one plausible additional conclusion from the lie beyond the exact statement you made. The GM chooses a conclusion consistent with what the target already knows; it may create an opportunity or a complication.

LooseThread.Title: Loose Thread
LooseThread.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Lie first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The target catches one specific inconsistency, omission, or detail that made the story fail. The GM should identify the point of suspicion without revealing information the target could not reasonably know.

ContradictionCascade.Title: Contradiction Cascade
ContradictionCascade.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Lie first. Your next attempt to Lie to the same target about the same topic within 10 minutes takes a -1 circumstance penalty. The penalty then ends.

SuspicionSpreads.Title: Suspicion Spreads
SuspicionSpreads.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Lie first. There is no additional mechanical effect. One nearby observer who can follow the conversation picks up on the target's skepticism and becomes wary of the same claim. This does not automatically change attitudes or impose a rules condition.

MannerismLockedIn.Title: Mannerism Locked In
MannerismLockedIn.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Impersonate first. Your next Impersonate or Deception check within 10 minutes to maintain the same identity gains a +1 circumstance bonus. The bonus then ends.

BelievableRoutine.Title: Believable Routine
BelievableRoutine.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Impersonate first. There is no additional mechanical effect. An observer treats your assumed role as ordinary enough to volunteer a minor contextual detail, expectation, name, or routine that someone in that role would plausibly know.

DetailOutOfPlace.Title: Detail Out of Place
DetailOutOfPlace.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Impersonate first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The observer notices one concrete mismatch in voice, posture, clothing, manner, terminology, or local custom. The GM should reveal what looked wrong if the observer could reasonably make that judgment.

RoleDrift.Title: Role Drift
RoleDrift.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Impersonate first. Your next Impersonate check using the same assumed identity within 10 minutes takes a -1 circumstance penalty unless you first spend 1 minute correcting the disguise, mannerisms, or story. After either event, this consequence ends.
